approach.title: How a project is born

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: I break the task into steps and define the smallest working version.

steps.title: Build an MVP
steps.text: First the simplest version that works from start to finish.

steps.title: Iterate
steps.text: I add features one at a time, refactor and check edge cases.

steps.title: Reflect
steps.text: After every project I write down what worked and what I'd do differently.

approach.quote: The documentation says one thing, the API does another. The museum API's search only ranked results instead of filtering them, and stopped at a thousand records. Now I check the API's answers by hand first and only then write the code.

about.text: I'm Iryna, a Python developer. I like problems where code takes over the routine: a script that checks shops every day, a bot that plays a game on its own, an app that reads a PDF aloud. I build backends with Flask, work with data in pandas and make desktop apps. Right now I'm building complete web apps with payments, tests and multilingual interfaces.
